bio_long: I'm a creative and results-driven multimedia professional based in Tema, Ghana, with 5+ years of experience spanning graphic design, video production, social media management, and digital marketing. I'm passionate about digital design and art direction, and enjoy solving problems through beautiful designs and experiences with agencies and enthusiastic people. I have a track record of building brand identities, growing engaged online communities, and delivering measurable ROI through compelling visual storytelling — including a Twitter campaign that trended at #1. I'm adept at managing multi-channel campaigns from concept to execution, and I bring the same creative energy whether I'm designing a brand identity, directing a music video, or optimising a paid social campaign.
